data.raw_text:
I stand with Mayors Benjie Magalong of Baguio City, Iloilo City’s Raisa Treñas, Pasig’s Vico Sotto, and Isko Moreno of Manila  in demanding full transparency and proper accountability for greater transparency and accountability in flood control projects which are funded by the people’s money.

Kaisa tayo sa kanilang paninindigan na dapat nagagamit sa tama ang pera ng taumbayan at talagang napoprotektahan sila sa baha ng mga proyekyong ito, sa halip na gamitin bilang gatasan ng mga tiwaling opisyal.

There is a need to review the flood control strategies being implemented by the DPWH and other concerned agencies to be more cost-effective, suitable, innovative, and efficient to address the worsening conditions during the typhoon season in the Philippines.
